title: An extrinsic failure yields BLOCKED and is never cached or reused as FAIL
statement: An extrinsic probe or environment failure in the check runner MUST yield BLOCKED for the probe and blocked-environment for every dependent, MUST NOT be written to the result cache as FAIL, and MUST NOT be reused on a later plan even when the task key is unchanged.
rationale: ADR-CHK-0001 and ADR-CHK-0002 apply Article 41 to the check runner: a toolchain or environment fault names the fix, it never becomes a candidate defect.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
